text:
In this existential form no index set, ultrafilter or cardinal bound is
named.  As published, the forward implication fixes an infinite cardinal
\(\lambda\), puts \(\mu=\min\{\mu:\lambda^\mu>\lambda\}\), and supplies one
ultrafilter \(D\) over \(\lambda\) with
\(\mathcal M^\lambda/D\cong\mathcal N^\lambda/D\) for all elementarily
equivalent \(\mathcal M\), \(\mathcal N\) of power less than \(\mu\)
\cite[224]{Shelah1971Ultrapowers}; see
\cref{thm:p03-w03-p03-018-shelah}.  Isomorphic ultrapowers do not make
\(\mathcal M\) and \(\mathcal N\) isomorphic
(\cref{thm:p03-w03-p03-018-separation}).
